name: dairy-360
description: AI agent for dairy farm management (read/write tool split with human-in-the-loop confirmation).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,angular -c blue,red "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w web-angular"
scripts.dev:angular: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,angular -c blue,red "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w web-angular"
scripts.build:angular: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w web-angular
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts._verify_note: check:contrast passes --report so it PRINTS rather than exits non-zero: 33 pairs fail AA today and they are recorded in PHASE5_PRECHECK.md section 1, not regressions. Drop the flag to use it as a gate once they are fixed. `shots` needs `harness:app` up, or a production build behind serve-built.mjs -- see UI_SYSTEM.md section 10.6 on why a screenshot of a stale bundle is not evidence.
scripts._harness_note: The one command for seeing the app work without a real database. `harness:app` starts the in-memory registry harness on 6400 (the port proxy.conf.json targets, so it is mutually exclusive with `dev` -- that is the point), seeds a readable herd into it, and starts Angular. NOT the same dummy data as `npm run seed`: that one recreates the six DEMO tables the agent chat reads, in dairy.db. These two are deliberately separate systems -- see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md section 6.
scripts.harness:app: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n harness,seed,angular -c blue,green,red "npm run registry:harness -w server -- --port=6400 --empty" "node scripts/harness-seed.mjs --wait=90" "npm run start -w web-angular"
